BY RENTAL CAR
Luxembourg, located in the Heart of Europe, is the ideal connecting point for train travel to
any destination in Europe. There is a bus every half hour from the airport to the downtown
Car rental rates in Luxembourg are among the lowest on the Continent. Another ad-
air terminal next to the railway station. One way fare is Lfrs. 50 (approx. $1.50).
vantage of renting a car in Luxembourg is the fact that there is no tax on car rental,
only a flat fee of 100 FR. Most other countries add a tax of 10% to 20%.
